authoritative_source: KITTI tracking devkit format and official TrackEval KITTI adapter, https://github.com/JonathonLuiten/TrackEval/blob/master/docs/KITTI-format.txt
description: KITTI Tracking native-to-common class mapping. Native labels are preserved separately and mapped without evaluation-time filtering.
notes: The devkit documents eight object classes plus DontCare.
The inspected tracking labels use Person where the devkit prose uses Person_sitting; official TrackEval identifies Person as the sitting-person distractor class.
DontCare is retained as an event and is not silently filtered.
Unknown native labels are rejected rather than mapped to an implicit other class.
